'''R5-D7''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] droid that captured the blueprints of the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] and the data of the [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class Droid Control Ship]] for the Republic. He was probably destroyed by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] when he destroyed the Droid Control Ship over [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].
